name: ENEOS
verdict: Owned by ENEOS Corporation, which its Company Overview page states is a 100% investment of ENEOS Holdings, Inc. The page names no shareholder above ENEOS Holdings.
note: Official Sponsor of the Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP team: ENEOS USA's MotoGP page says it 'proudly sponsors Yamaha Factory Racing, working with the Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP team', and the logo is listed under Official Sponsors on the team's official sponsors page (2026).
